label: V4.2.51
notes: Remove all center/right display modes from the FSAGS/BBBT coordinate system. All managed text fields render from the left edge of vx with text-anchor=start, leftValue=true and manualInset=0. Existing schema-2 coordinate files are accepted but their alignment properties are ignored. New exports use schema 3 and contain geometry only (vx/vy/vw/vh). Remove field-specific Refer/signer alignment patches and use one generic render authority after native draw. Preserve signature images, touch/input regions, AD coordinate editor, report functions, Quick Incident removal and performance behavior.
